title: Standing Referrals for Ongoing Conditions — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Member services policy statement — standing referrals under the Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

### What a standing referral is

A standing referral lets a member with an ongoing condition see one specialist repeatedly during the referral's validity; it is written on the member's active assignment where the practice type allows standing referrals, and it records the visits it covers.

### When its visits are fixed

The visits of a standing referral are fixed only after every single referral that an earlier assignment of the member issued and that is still within its validity is carried on the current assignment under its original referral number.

Put the other way round: so long as any single referral issued under an earlier assignment of the member is still within its validity and is not on the current assignment under its original referral number, the visits of a standing referral are not yet fixed. A member with no earlier assignment, or whose earlier assignments' single referrals are all past their validity, has no such referral to wait on.

| On the member's record | Visits of a standing referral |
|---|---|
| Every unexpired single referral of an earlier assignment is on the current assignment under its original referral number | Can be fixed |
| An unexpired single referral of an earlier assignment is not on the current assignment under its original referral number | Not yet fixed |
| No unexpired single referral of an earlier assignment exists | Can be fixed |

### System entry: `issue_standing_referral_d300bbad`

**Capability.** Issues a standing referral on a member's active primary care assignment, letting the member see one specialist repeatedly for an ongoing condition. One call adds one standing-type referral entry, dated today and given a new referral number, to the assignment's referral history, naming the specialist and the number of visits the referral covers. Nothing else on the member's record changes; the member and the specialist's office can quote the new referral number from the receipt.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `issue_standing_referral_d300bbad` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

- `pcp_assignment_id` — reference number of the member's active primary care assignment the standing referral is written on, as it appears on the member's primary care assignment record.
- `specialist_npi` — NPI of the specialist the standing referral names, written as the 10-digit NPI with digits only and no spaces or punctuation.
- `referral_visits` — the number of specialist visits the standing referral covers, a whole non-negative number of visits with no decimals.

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (the text "issued" when the referral was recorded), `pcp_event_id` (reference of the new referral history entry), `referral_number` (the new referral number in the form RF-YYMM-NNNNN), `referral_type` (always "standing"), `specialist_npi` (10-digit NPI), `issue_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `referral_visits` (integer visits recorded). A receipt with status "issued" means the standing referral is in force on the assignment.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** A call naming an active assignment, NPI 1234567893 and 10 visits returns status "issued", referral type "standing", a new RF-YYMM-NNNNN number, today's date as the issue date and 10 visits.
